title: Subarray Product Less Than K
constraints: All array values are positive, enabling a monotonic sliding window.

examples.explanation: Every non-empty subarray has product 1, so all six subarrays count.

solutionApproaches.title: Enumerate All Ranges
solutionApproaches.explanation: Multiply each range from every start index; correct but too slow at the maximum array length.

solutionApproaches.title: Sliding Window
solutionApproaches.explanation: Expand right, shrink left while product >= k. Every window ending at right contributes right-left+1 subarrays.
